introduction: This Webb field combines observed galaxies with a map of something the telescope cannot see directly: dark matter.
observe: Find the blue overlay before looking at individual galaxies.
Notice that the blue behaves like a map, not like light emitted by the objects.
explanation: Researchers inferred the distribution of invisible dark matter from its gravitational effect on the shapes of many background galaxies.
colorMethod: Blue is an assigned data layer representing inferred dark-matter density. Brighter blue indicates greater density; it is not the visible color of dark matter.
whyItMatters: The image establishes the central rule of the Trail: astronomical color can encode measurement and interpretation as well as visible light.
